name: Shun Premier 8 inch Chef's Knife (TDM0706)
where: Williams Sonoma, Cherry Creek Shopping Center (3000 E 1st Ave, Denver) and Park Meadows (8401 Park Meadows Center Dr, Lone Tree). Sur La Table, Streets at SouthGlenn (6853 S York St, Centennial).
engravedSurfaces: Blade: VG-MAX stainless core clad in 69 layers of Damascus stainless, hammered (tsuchime) finish on the upper blade with a polished flat above the edge. Handle: walnut color PakkaWood (resin-impregnated hardwood) with a stainless end cap.
notes: Maker site shows regular price $275.00, currently on sale at $219.95 (2026-09-16). Williams Sonoma lists it around $199.95 to $209.95 on sale. Maker image is 700 px PNG, converted to jpg.

name: Miyabi Birchwood SG2 8 inch Chef's Knife (34373-203)
where: Williams Sonoma, Cherry Creek and Park Meadows. Sur La Table, Centennial. Both list the Birchwood line.
engravedSurfaces: Blade: SG2 micro-carbide powder steel core, 101-layer Damascus stainless cladding with a flower pattern, Honbazuke hand-honed edge. Handle: Karelian (Masur) birch, D-shaped, with a stainless end cap and mosaic pin.
notes: Maker (zwilling.com) shows list $364.99, on sale at $299.99 (2026-09-16). Williams Sonoma lists $299.95. The user's model code 5000MCD is the Japanese series name; the US item number is 34373-203. Maker og:image is the 34373-201 file (same knife, catalog photo).

name: Wusthof Classic Ikon 8 inch Chef's Knife (1040330120)
where: Williams Sonoma, Cherry Creek and Park Meadows. Sur La Table, Centennial. Both carry the Classic Ikon line.
engravedSurfaces: Blade: precision-forged high-carbon stainless steel (X50CrMoV15), 58 HRC, satin finish, wide flat above the edge. Handle: black POM (polyoxymethylene) synthetic, triple riveted, double bolster.
notes: Maker Shopify data: Black 1040330120 at $200.00, Creme variant 1040430120 on sale at $159.00. Wusthof now titles it Chef's Knife (formerly Cook's Knife).

name: Benchmade 940 Osborne
where: Cabela's Lone Tree (10670 Cabela Dr) stocks Benchmade. Rocky Mountain Specialty Gear, Wheat Ridge, is a Benchmade dealer. Scheels Johnstown lists the 940 but is north of the metro. Otherwise ordered in from benchmade.com.
engravedSurfaces: Blade: CPM-S30V stainless, 58 to 60 HRC, satin finish, reverse tanto. Handle: 6061-T6 anodized aluminum in green with a purple anodized backspacer. Laser marks the anodized aluminum bright silver (bare metal under the anodize), so text on the scales reads silver on green.
notes: Maker Shopify data: SKU 940, $300.00, in stock (2026-09-16). Image is the second maker photo (open knife, flat lay), the first is a hero shot.

name: Chris Reeve Small Sebenza 31 (plain titanium, drop point)
where: Colorado authorized dealers per chrisreeve.com: Castle Gate (Sedalia, Douglas County), Rocky Mountain Specialty Gear (Wheat Ridge), Bucking Rainbow Outfitters (Steamboat Springs). No dealer inside the south metro proper, so plan on Castle Gate or ordered in from chrisreeve.com.
engravedSurfaces: Handle: 6Al4V titanium slabs, bead-blasted matte, with the integral lock bar on the back slab. Laser marks titanium a dark grey, or gold to blue with a color anneal. Blade: current production is stonewashed CPM MagnaCut (63 to 64 HRC), earlier production CPM S45VN.
notes: Maker sells Small and Large as variants of one listing: Small SKU S31-1000 $425.00, Large L31-1000 $500.00, both in stock (2026-09-16). Product photo on the listing is the Large (L31-1000), same design at 7.0 inch overall vs the Small's 6.98 inch closed-to-open spec; no separate Small photo published.

name: Spyderco Para Military 2, black G-10, plain edge (C81GP2)
where: Spyderco Factory Outlet, 820 Spyderco Way, Golden (Mon to Fri 9 to 5, Sat 10 to 5, Sun 10 to 4, 303-279-8383 ext 1), full current lineup on display with in-store discounts. Cabela's Lone Tree also stocks Spyderco.
engravedSurfaces: Handle: black G-10 (fiberglass-epoxy laminate), textured peel-ply finish, over skeletonized stainless liners. Laser marks G-10 a light grey. Blade: CPM S45VN stainless, full-flat ground, satin.
notes: Maker Shopify data: C81GP2 PlainEdge Black $279.00 MSRP, in stock; DLC black blade C81GPBK2 is $299.00 (2026-09-16). Current production is S45VN, not S30V.

name: Smithey No. 12 Cast Iron Skillet
where: Williams Sonoma carries Smithey (Cherry Creek and Park Meadows, confirm the No. 12 on the floor). Ace Hardware stocks the No. 12 (SKU SMITH-CI-SKIL12) for store pickup at neighborhood Ace stores. Otherwise ordered in from smithey.com.
engravedSurfaces: Cast iron, seasoned. Interior is machine-polished smooth, exterior is a satin cast finish. Engrave the underside of the pan or the top of the handle; laser removes the seasoning to bare grey iron, then re-season.
notes: Maker Shopify data: $220.00, in stock (2026-09-16). Image is the maker's second studio photo (the og:image is a lifestyle hero PNG).

name: John Boos RA03 Reversible Maple Cutting Board, 24 x 18 x 2-1/4
where: Williams Sonoma (Cherry Creek, Park Meadows) and Sur La Table (Centennial) both carry Boos boards, but mostly their own exclusive sizes. The RA03 itself is ordered in from johnboos.com or a restaurant supply (WebstaurantStore, KaTom).
engravedSurfaces: Northern hard rock maple, edge grain, oil finish (Boos Mystery Oil). Engrave on either face (it is reversible) or on the 2-1/4 inch end edge beside the finger grip. Laser marks maple a warm brown.
notes: Maker page shows $200.95 for the RA-Board series page (2026-09-16); the page displays one price across the four sizes, so confirm the 24 x 18 at checkout. The RA03 is 2-1/4 inch thick and about 30 lb, not 1-1/2 inch; Boos' 1-1/2 inch boards are the R series (R03 is 24 x 18 x 1-1/2) and their price was not verified. Maker image is a styled product shot from the Boos CMS, not a white-background studio cutout.

name: YETI Tundra 45 Hard Cooler
where: YETI store, Cherry Creek North (3030 E 2nd Ave Ste 101, Denver, 720-204-2041). REI Denver flagship (1416 Platte St) and REI Greenwood Village (9000 E Peakview Ave). Cabela's Lone Tree. Ace Hardware stores also stock Tundra.
engravedSurfaces: Lid and body: rotomolded polyethylene (one-piece, PermaFrost foam inside). Engrave the lid top; laser marks the colored polyethylene a lighter matte tone. Latches are rubber, hardware is stainless.
notes: Maker page data: $325.00, SKU 10045450024 (2026-09-16). yeti.com blocks WebFetch but answered curl with a browser UA. The og:image is the Stag Red colorway; swap the color code in the imgix path if you want White or Navy.

name: Snow Peak Titanium Flask L (T-013)
where: REI carries Snow Peak titanium drinkware (Denver flagship, Greenwood Village) but the T-013 shows as unavailable everywhere checked. Ordered in, or substitute.
engravedSurfaces: Titanium (Japanese, made in Tsubame-Sanjo), brushed. Laser marks titanium dark grey, or gold to blue with a color anneal. Engrave the flat face.
notes: NOT VERIFIED AT THE MAKER. snowpeak.com/products/flask-titanium-1 (the T-013 page) now returns 404 and the T-013 is absent from the maker's flasks collection (2026-09-16). Price $179.95 is Outland USA's list price, shown as currently unavailable; a 2026 search snippet cited $170 back-ordered at Snow Peak. Capacity per retailer spec is 6 fl oz, not 7 oz. Image is the retailer's studio photo. In-production substitutes on snowpeak.com: Titanium Flask in 250 mL (TW-115) $179.95 in stock, Titanium Flask M (T-012, 140 mL) $169.95 sold out.

name: Leatherman FREE P4
where: Discontinued. Remaining stock only: Cabela's Lone Tree and REI (Denver, Greenwood Village) still have listings, call before driving. Used units on the Leatherman Exchange.
engravedSurfaces: Handles: stainless steel, satin, with a flat outer face on each side. Blade: 420HC stainless. Laser marks stainless dark grey or black (anneal).
notes: Leatherman retired the FREE P2 and P4 in September 2025 (multitool.org); the maker URL now redirects to the Retired Products page, which is where this maker photo comes from. $149.95 is the last MSRP as listed by KnifeCenter (discontinued), not a live maker price. The successor is the Leatherman ARC.

name: Ridge Wallet, Carbon Fiber 3K (Cash Strap)
where: Best Buy stocks the 3K Cash Strap (SKU A0456) for store pickup at south metro stores. Nordstrom Cherry Creek and Park Meadows list the Carbon Fiber 3K (money clip variant). Scheels Johnstown also carries it.
engravedSurfaces: Plates: 3K carbon fiber weave in epoxy, matte. Laser marks the resin a light grey over the weave. Frame screws and cash strap are aluminum and stainless.
notes: Maker Shopify data: Cash Strap variant $150.00, in stock (2026-09-16). ridge.com blocks WebFetch and plain curl but serves the products .js endpoint.
